name: Xihe
description: A star 139 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 91852: radius 12.372 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 72.396 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.065) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 91852: effective temperature 4790 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.103)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 2.57 from 2024A&A...691A..53S; the 9 published values span log g 2.35 to 2.6, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 91852: distance 139.47 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.039), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 139 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 72 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,790 K, so 12.372 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 91852: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: HD 173416
quotes.card: HD 173416, also named Xihe, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet in the northern constellation of Lyra.
quotes.introduction: It is located at a distance of approximately 433 light-years based on parallax measurements, but is drifting closer to the Sun with a radial velocity of −61 km/s.
